user_story.summary: Full PO lifecycle on admin panel — create through Ready
user_story.want: to create a Purchase Order for a vendor with multiple line items, accept it, edit a detail if needed, pack it from the warehouse, upload the ready proof document, and mark it Ready for pickup — all from the admin panel in one continuous flow
user_story.benefit: I can fulfil a vendor PO end-to-end without switching contexts and without leaving any state half-saved between steps; each milestone is independently visible if anything goes wrong
acceptance_criteria: Create form opens from the PO listing page
Vendor selection auto-populates Billing and Shipping addresses
Save Changes is gated until at least one valid line item is present (different products per row)
After save, the new PO appears at /#/oms/po/all/<id>/show with a numeric ID
Accept transitions the PO to Accepted state
Edit form opens at /#/oms/po/all/<id> (no /show suffix) and Update returns to /show
Pack action moves PO to Packed state (with a Confirm dialog)
Ready Proof upload accepts an image file
Mark Ready transitions PO to Ready state
No error toasts surface during the lifecycle

test_steps.expected: PO listing loads with Create button visible
Create PO form opens with Vendor Information section
Billing and Shipping addresses auto-populate from vendor profile

test_steps.action: Open Agrim Branch dropdown, select ODISHA
test_steps.expected: Branch set, delivery address dropdown enables

test_steps.action: Open Select Address dropdown, click CUTTACK WH
Open Load Type dropdown, click Full Load
Open PO Type, pick Inventory Purchase; pick Type of Inventory Purchase = Business Purchase
Type 'test' in row-1 product search, pick first autocomplete item, fill quantity 7
test_steps.expected: Row 1 wired with product, quantity, total visible

test_steps.action: Click Add New Row, type 'test' in row-2 product search, pick SECOND autocomplete item, fill quantity 8 and rate 8
test_steps.expected: Row 2 has a DIFFERENT product from row 1; both rows valid

test_steps.action: Wait for Save Changes wrapper to enable (opacity 1), click it
Verify vendor name visible on detail page
test_steps.expected: Detail page shows the created PO with the vendor name

test_steps.action: Click 'Pack at <warehouse>' button; accept any Confirm dialog
Open Proof section, click 'Click to Upload Document', set fixture image via file chooser
test_steps.expected: Document uploaded, file shows in proof section
No errors visible — lifecycle completed cleanly
